agentUtterance.text: In order to fix the issue, we will run our Virtual Repair process. Some tests take several minutes to run and while troubleshooting, your services may be temporarily disrupted. This process is also available through the MyBell app and has written instructions with images specific to the equipment in your home. Before I start the process, did you want me to send the link to the device you're calling from to run Virtual Repair in the MyBell app instead?
I am sorry to know that you are not happy with the virtual assistant. Would you like me to send the link via text message, or should we run the tests together over the phone?

playbookInput.precedingConversationSummary: Customer has  a VR issue, VR is asking for the consent to either send the sms or initiate the VR process

playbookOutput.executionSummary: The user reported an internet issue and then expressed frustration and used profanity when presented with the initial Virtual Repair instructions. In response, the bot empathetically acknowledged the frustration and concisely reprompted the user to choose between receiving an SMS link or running tests over the phone, avoiding any repetition of the lengthy opening script.
